Dragon-head title of Uther and the royal line.

How Pendragon connects

  • Character: Uther Pendragon — Uther took the Pendragon name and standard.
  • Character: King Arthur — Arthur inherits the Pendragon claim.

What is Pendragon?

Pendragon is the war-standard and surname of Uther and Arthur: a claim to British high kingship that later storytellers treat as the family name of Camelot.

Key threads lead to Uther Pendragon and King Arthur.
